notes: Searched for Axelios/SBX core and service-provider rates, Broad Clinical Labs service pricing and early-access customers. I ran 4 searches and opened 1 page (Lab Manager). No core facility, provider or early-access site has published an Axelios price or an Axelios run rate. No page says a site paused or reduced Illumina purchases pending Axelios. Only Roche's own list figures turned up ($750K instrument, $150 per genome, $0.06 per million reads), all already known. The Lab Manager article quotes CWRU's 25B tier, about $203–260 per genome sequencing-only and about $231 midpoint. That is the Illumina side only, and CWRU's 25B price is already known. I did not open the CNAG or Hartwig pages directly or check the 29 Jun 2026 Roche release for named sites. The search engine also returned no hits for them.
how_to_mine: Only if you want a deeper look: check the named early-access customers' own sites one by one (Hartwig, CNAG, Sanger, Macrogen, Centogene, SAGA, Broad Clinical Labs service catalog). Search each site for 'AXELIOS' or 'SBX' with 'price' or 'service request'. Also re-run the search at the end of 2026, because the commercial launch was only 29 Jun 2026 and core rate cards usually refresh at fiscal-year start (Jul 2026 or Jan 2027).
